title: No new permission appears in Roles & Permissions
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Roles & Permissions.
  2. Open a role to see its permission list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Roles & Permissions page lists the roles.

Step 2:

  • The permission list still shows 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • It has no permission named for tiers, matrices or pricing tiers.
